test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

A car full of explosives was apprehended today by the forces.

options.text: The forces have apprehended a car full of explosives today.
A car full of explosives has apprehended the forces today.
The forces are apprehending a car full of explosives today.
The forces apprehended a car full of explosives today.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The forces apprehended a car full of explosives today.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the Past Simple tense and we need to change it into the active form.
 
• The Past Simple in the passive voice has the following form: Subject + was/were + past participle + by object__
 
• The Past Simple in the active voice has the following form: __Subject + past participle + object__
 __
 
• Passive: *The floor was cleaned by Reema.*
 
• Active: *Reema cleaned the floor.*
 
 
 
• In the active voice of the Past Simple, we have to change the structure, so the subject in the passive voice becomes the object in the active voice.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct Active Voice:__ *The forces apprehended a car full of explosives today.*
